# forgejo_team_repository (Resource)

Forgejo team repository resource. Assigns a repository to an organization team.

**Note**: The team and repository must belong to the same organization. Teams with `includes_all_repositories = true` already have access to every repository of the organization and can not be managed by this resource. A team that is switched to `includes_all_repositories = true` afterwards keeps the explicit association. Destroying this resource removes the association without deleting the team or repository.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    forgejo = {
      source = "svalabs/forgejo"
    }
  }
}

provider "forgejo" {
  host = "http://localhost:3000"
}

# Organization
resource "forgejo_organization" "owner" {
  name = "test_org"
}

# Repository
resource "forgejo_repository" "repo" {
  owner = forgejo_organization.owner.name
  name  = "some_repo"
}

# Team
resource "forgejo_team" "team" {
  organization_id           = forgejo_organization.owner.id
  name                      = "org_test_team"
  includes_all_repositories = false

  units_map = {
    "repo.code" = "read"
  }
}

# Team repository
resource "forgejo_team_repository" "example" {
  team_id       = forgejo_team.team.id
  repository_id = forgejo_repository.repo.id
}

# Import team repository
# id follows the format: <org_name>/<team_name>/<repo_name>
import {
  id = "test_org/org_test_team/some_repo"
  to = forgejo_team_repository.example
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repository_id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the repository. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
- `team_id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the team. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the association in team_id/repository_id format.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Import using the org_name/team_name/repo_name.
terraform import forgejo_team_repository.example test_org/org_test_team/some_repo
```
